releaseNotes: Big update: sidebar is now a permanent Product Database panel instead of an overflow menu (always visible, no more auto-hiding). Template/layout moved into the top bar's Edit menu; Scheduled Ads/Trash moved into Settings; Quick How-To is now a top-right '?' button. New: reusable templates (Save as template / Use) with two starter templates included (Christmas, Thanksgiving). Overlays can now be rotated and text overlays get a size control. Bigger buttons throughout, and naming an unsaved ad now saves it immediately like Google Docs.
